title: Comments in Kotlin
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of comments in kotlin using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates comments in kotlin.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Comments in Kotlin** as part of **Kotlin Syntax and Basic Structure**. Apply comments in kotlin by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Single-Line Comments, Multiline Comments, Documentation Comments—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.

content_blocks.title: Troubleshooting and reset
content_blocks.text: If the example fails, first confirm which runtime/project type the snippet requires. Read the first useful compiler or runtime message, check imports and declared dependencies, reduce the example to a minimal case, and rerun. For target-specific code, use the target toolchain rather than assuming a console or browser runner can execute it.
